_home_labels: Display names for the rows on the postal-code tab, in order. Used only when that row has no label of its own. Postal codes are never written into the built page.
_home_overrides: Homes whose postal code OneMap cannot resolve, keyed by the label on the sheet. Coordinates only: this file is public, and the postal codes and block numbers deliberately are not. Delete an entry once the sheet's own code resolves.

Ben hse.why: The code on the sheet has a digit wrong and resolves to nothing. These are the coordinates of the code the owner confirmed. Delete this entry once the sheet is corrected.

_walk_speed: Metres per minute used for every walking estimate.
_bbox: Recomputed by refresh.py to cover every place, home and station. Changing it makes build.py fetch a fresh set of tiles.
_mrt: Candidate stations. refresh.py keeps only those that come out nearest to something, so adding one here is harmless.
_short_names: Map labels for names too long to sit on the map. Anything not listed is shortened automatically at a word boundary.
_mrt_network: data/stations.json is the whole MRT network, fetched from OneMap and used only to name the nearest station in the table. The 'mrt' list above is a separate thing: the handful of stations drawn on the map. Delete data/stations.json to refetch.
_mrt_lines_excluded: Cross Island and Jurong Region line stations are in OneMap's index but not in passenger service, so naming one as your nearest station would be a station you cannot catch a train at. Remove a code here once its line opens.
